finalization_gaps.missing: CP adapter now authenticates existing Control a17 v1 evidence and a signed companion bound to fixed run/attempt/lease/plan/certificate/CA context. Independent actual OpenSSH possession/certificate verification and trusted context derivation remain to be implemented by the attester before signing. No lease reservation API needed: a17 accepts signed attester-chosen lease_id and owns permanent uniqueness.
Pull/W1-W5 remain proposed; no protected runtime transport adapter is enabled.
Public trust owner exists; hosted manifest, immutable floor/CA, purpose-separated custody and load-once startup identity adapters are not configured in this slice.
No approved receipt producer identity, signature purpose or pinned verification anchor. Report hashes do not authenticate a producer or attester.
Issuer command receipts only record non-authorizing DB retries. They are not E receipts. First-create atomic durable E publication, conflict handling and retention destination remain absent.
Published wheel records prove installable dependencies, not accepted B/C1/C2/D. All acceptance references remain unknown; D18 live convergence is separate.
